mapper.sql: id, client_id, status, tenant_id, create_uid, create_time, update_uid, update_time, delete_flag, delete_time, delete_uid
mapper.select: SELECT tc.id, tc.tenant_id, tc.client_id, tc.status, c.app_name AS appName, c.category, c.icon, c.description, c.website, c.status AS clientStatus FROM t_tenant_client tc LEFT JOIN t_client c ON tc.client_id = c.client_id AND c.delete_flag = 0 WHERE tc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tc.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY tc.id ASC

SELECT id, client_id, status, tenant_id, create_uid, create_time, update_uid, update_time, delete_flag, delete_time, delete_uid FROM t_tenant_client WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND client_id = #{clientId} LIMIT 1
